scope: CHARLS sons minus daughters contact by baseline education
missing_variable: ADL only; original observed values and XYZ masks preserved
additional_auxiliaries: 25 observed X_i Z_j products by education plus their product missingness flags by education
retained_auxiliaries: Existing X/Y/Z-by-education and urban terms, 25 XZ products, original controls and missingness flags
compatibility: Conditional working MI with observed product auxiliaries; not proof of MAR or exact latent congeniality.
cache: Only deterministic identical conditional fit. Fresh parameter, random-effect and donor draws for all 20 imputations.
reuse: Pilot estimates are numerical feasibility evidence only; new MI data require new member estimates.
